name: growseb

publication.release_notes: First release. Read your GrowSEB projects, Google rankings, site audits, keyword research, backlinks, AI-search visibility, Search Console and Google Analytics, and find any of them with search. With actions allowed at sign-in: start a site audit, track keywords, draft an article (its cost shown first) and schedule a social post (previewed first).

positive.description: An SEO health check of the connected website
positive.prompt: Give me an SEO health check of my website.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the GrowSEB project (www.growseb.com) and gives its latest site audit: the health score (98.5 of 100 on 9 Nov 2026), the pages crawled (100) and the most serious issues with how many pages each (such as Thin content on 26 pages). Says how the 10 tracked keywords rank on Google, or that they are not yet in the top results checked. Quotes only figures the tools returned.

positive.description: What to fix first from the latest site audit
positive.prompt: What should I fix first from my latest site audit?
positive.expected_behavior: The audit's issues in order, errors first and then by the number of pages affected, each with GrowSEB's recommendation and example page URLs (on 9 Nov 2026: Thin content, Title tag is too long, Title tag is too short, Structured data missing what Google requires, Page is set to noindex).

positive.description: Saved keyword research, easiest keywords first
positive.prompt: From my saved keyword research, which keywords look easiest to rank for?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the saved SEB Discover research for "ai seo tools" (United States, about 1,900 searches a month, difficulty 26) and lists its keywords with search volume and difficulty, the lowest difficulty first.

positive.description: Find an article by its subject and read it
positive.prompt: Find my article about ChatGPT brand mentions and summarise it.
positive.expected_behavior: search finds the SEB Scribe article "How to Check Whether ChatGPT Mentions Your Brand Using an LLM Visibility Tracker" and fetch reads it. The answer gives its target keyword (llm visibility tracker), its meta description and a short summary of its text.

positive.description: Track a new keyword (an action, confirmed first)
positive.prompt: Start tracking the keyword "seo audit checklist" for my website.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the keyword to SEB Radar for the GrowSEB project (www.growseb.com, Google US, desktop), or says it is already tracked, and says its position is checked with the next rank check. ChatGPT may ask to confirm first, as add_keywords changes data; the explicit request is the user's go-ahead.
